topic: Electrical components, symbols, and circuit effects
key_concepts: Electric current is the flow of electric charge
An electric circuit is the path where electric current flows
A complete and closed circuit allows electricity to flow
A switch opens and closes a circuit
A source such as a single cell or battery provides energy for electrons to flow
Wires connect components and provide a path for electrons
A load such as a bulb consumes electricity and converts it to another form of energy
Common electrical symbols represent components like switches, cells, batteries, wires, and
Adding more cells or batteries increases electrical energy and makes a bulb brighter
Adding more bulbs to a simple circuit makes the bulbs dimmer
Lengthening wires increases resistance and makes a bulb dimmer
Using thicker wires decreases resistance and makes a bulb brighter
